reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 2(a) engages Contractor on a task-by-task basis under individual SOWs and § 3(a) provides time-and-materials compensation plus actual expenses, with no minimum, shortfall, take-or-pay or volume-cap language.
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no deterministic checks failed.

Rationale correctly maps the clause to the preferred position (fees for ordered services only) and flags the practical follow-up (review any future SOW introducing committed hours or a retainer) as a note rather than a deviation; the passing reference to § 6(a) termination for convenience is supporting context and does not affect the classification.
